description: The extended edition of The Two Towers recut into four sequential chapters, following the divided Fellowship through Rohan, Gollum's return, Isengard's war and Helm's Deep.

s02e01.description: The broken Fellowship follows three separate paths as Aragorn, Legolas and Gimli pursue the captured Hobbits while Frodo and Sam enter harsher country toward Mordor. Their journey gains an unwilling guide when the Ring's former owner, Gollum, is finally caught.

s02e02.description: The hunters' pursuit across Rohan leads to an impossible reunion with Gandalf, returned with greater purpose. As Théoden's kingdom is pulled out of Saruman's shadow, Frodo and Sam continue east with Gollum, whose usefulness is matched only by the danger of trusting him.

s02e03.description: War gathers around Rohan while old choices shape each branch of the journey. Théoden leads his people toward refuge, Merry and Pippin discover the slow anger of the Ents, and Frodo's path brings him into contact with Gondor as the past increasingly determines what everyone must do next.

s02e04.description: Saruman's army reaches Helm's Deep and forces Rohan into a desperate night-long defense while other battles against Isengard unfold elsewhere. Courage, reinforcements and unlikely allies decide whether the free peoples can survive long enough to face the larger war still coming.
